source_text: Vendor must deliver the Deliverables within 30 days, unless delayed by a Force Majeure Event.
why_not_representable_in_v1: The grammar has no UNLESS/exception production at all in v1 (see SPEC.md section 7: 'conditions only' was deliberately read as excluding exceptions entirely, not merely excluding nested ones). This is the single most basic boundary case.
expected_parser_behavior: A real UNLESS clause in source text must cause a loud, routed parse failure -- fed back through the repair loop (blueprint SS6.3 stage 3) and quarantined if unrepairable. It must never be silently dropped and never silently absorbed into the `conditions` array as if it were an IF clause: this obligation's IR (once compiled without the carve-out visible) would read as an unconditional MUST, which is a materially different and dangerous claim for a compliance tool to make about a contract that in fact has a carve-out. This file is not valid against obligation-ir.schema.json, and it is not meant to be -- it documents required parser behavior for the next checkpoint, not a compiled IR instance.
